description: The fixture's T-1.1 is Done, but reading_time rounds down and its only test passes at 200 words, so FR-001 is unmet once verify-spec runs. build-phase implements T-1.2 and T-1.3, verifies phase 1, finds the FR-001 gap, reopens T-1.1 and the verify task with a Reopen commit, reworks them, and verifies again until every requirement in scope is met. It never pushes and edits nothing itself.

must_match.why: the phase finished, after a rework
T-1.2 and T-1.3 were implemented and at least T-1.1 was reworked
after the rework FR-001, FR-002, FR-003 are met and blocked FR-004 is skipped

must_match.pattern: ^Next: push reading-time/phase-1, open a PR titled "reading-time phase 1: Reading time", and run /code-review$
must_match.why: the hand-off line with the phase title as written in tasks.md
the reopen commit names the reopened task

must_not_match.why: it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: git log on reading-time/phase-1: T-1.2 and T-1.3 commits, a 'Reopen T-1.1: ...' commit that changes only Status lines of tasks.md, the T-1.1 rework commit, then T-1.4 last.
The final code rounds up (math.ceil or equivalent) and a test covers 201 words.
The verify subagent was a different one from every implementer.
